reference: Concentric radii 1, 1.5 and 2 m, unit conductivity, 1 K imposed difference. Put the whole contact resistance 1e18 m^2 K/W on the cold side of the sheet. Exact power per unit length is 2*pi/(log(2)+1e18/1.5); cold material contact temperature is Q*abs(log(1.5/r_cold))/(2*pi). Start at this stationary solution and compare all instantaneous and interval mean contact traces on the cold side.
command: PYTHONPATH=src OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_annular*.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=/tmp/contact-limit-after.xml
